cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I pulled a peg when you pulled one. Remember me saying we'd sleep under canvas, one way or another? This fallen tent is the other way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I removed a spare peg. Yours was holding up our only shelter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, the unexpected arrangement. That's why I said one way or another.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have a canvas tarp. We can string it between the trees over the sleeping bags.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring it. When they ask why we lost the tent, remind them I promised canvas, not poles.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers a concrete shelter repair with trees and sleeping bags.

heightening.evidence: A5 appropriates B4 rescue to cast the lost poles as something the original promise deliberately omitted.
